answer: Each agent must maintain a unique mirror-zephyr beacon on the horizon of its registered territory%2C verified by quarterly independent surveys that hash the beacon's reflection signature against the current zephyr pattern. Honest cost is one beacon and one survey (~300 USD). A sybil farmer needs a separate horizon placement and survey for every fake%3B shared mirrors or reused zephyr samples fail and burn the stake. This forces real capital and logistics per clone.
